clubs.name: ACM Student Chapter
clubs.tagLine: Empowering student technologists with open-source, hackathons, and research.
clubs.description: The primary computing and software development organization on campus. We organize hands-on technical workshops, competitive programming leagues, open source accelerators, and the annual flagship HackPulse hackathon.
requirements: Open to all majors with interest in technology
Commitment of 2-3 hours per week
Willingness to collaborate in team mini-projects
Attendance at at least 60% of general meetings

promises.title: Hands-on Full-Stack & AI Workshops
promises.description: Deliver 4 comprehensive practical tech sessions with working code repositories.

promises.title: Annual HackPulse 36-Hour Hackathon
promises.description: Host campus-wide hackathon with corporate mentors, prizes, and catering.

clubs.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems Lab
clubs.tagLine: Designing autonomous rovers, combat bots, and IoT sensor arrays.
clubs.description: Hands-on engineering guild where mechanical, electrical, and computer engineers combine forces to fabricate competitive robotics, autonomous drones, and embedded automation rigs.
requirements: Safety workshop completion (provided upon onboarding)
Passion for hardware prototyping, CAD, or microcontrollers
3-4 hours weekly lab time

promises.title: CAD & 3D Prototyping Bootcamp
promises.description: Certify all new recruits on Fusion 360 and CNC/3D printer lab equipment.

promises.title: Inter-University BattleBots Entry
promises.description: Fabricate and enter a 30lb combat bot in the Regional Championship.

clubs.name: Symphony & Western Music Society
clubs.tagLine: Harmonizing campus soul through live acoustic, rock, and orchestral compositions.
clubs.description: The premier musical ensemble representing the university at national college fests. We conduct vocal training, acoustic jam circles, sound engineering labs, and the annual campus unplugged night.
requirements: Open to vocalists, instrumentalists (guitar, drums, keys, bass, violin), and audio mixers
Willingness to rehearse 3-4 hours weekly for campus concerts
Passion for collaborative musical arrangement

promises.title: Annual Unplugged Campus Concert
promises.description: Organize the flagship acoustic amphitheater concert with 300+ attendees.

promises.title: Audio Mixing & Logic Pro Masterclass
promises.description: Hands-on studio production workshop for campus student musicians.

clubs.name: Nritya Pan-Campus Dance Troupe
clubs.tagLine: Celebrating rhythm, contemporary expression, and traditional classical dance.
clubs.description: Home to campus dancers across hip-hop, contemporary, classical, and urban street battles. Recipient of 5 inter-collegiate trophies across university youth festivals.
requirements: Rhythm assessment and team choreography workshop
Available for inter-university festival travel
Positive team spirit and discipline in group synchrony

promises.title: Inter-Collegiate Dance Fest Trophy Bid
promises.description: Represent the university at 3 national collegiate dance competitions.

clubs.name: Thespian Dramatics & Theater Society
clubs.tagLine: Stage plays, street theater (Nukkad Natak), and cinematic storytelling.
clubs.description: Producing impactful social satire, Shakespearean adaptations, and stagecraft workshops. We host the Annual Proscenium Theater Festival.
requirements: Vocal projection or backstage interest (lighting, props, set design)
Passion for storytelling and live theatre performance

promises.title: Annual Proscenium Stage Production
promises.description: Deliver a full-length 2-act theatrical play in the University Grand Auditorium.

clubs.name: University Football & Athletics Club
clubs.tagLine: Championship football, track sprinting, and high-performance athletic fitness.
clubs.description: Organizing the Inter-Branch Premier League, morning conditioning drills, and varsity tournament squads with certified coaching staff.
requirements: Medical fitness clearance from campus health center
Dedication to team practice 4 days a week
Punctuality and commitment to sportsmanship

promises.title: Inter-Branch Football Championship
promises.description: Host campus-wide 16-team tournament under stadium floodlights.

clubs.name: Hoops & Courts Basketball League
clubs.tagLine: Fast-break basketball, 3v3 streetball showdowns, and tactical scrimmage training.
clubs.description: Home of the campus varsity basketball team. We host regular intramural tournaments, 3-point shootouts, and tactical fitness bootcamps on floodlit campus courts.
requirements: Basic basketball fundamentals and court awareness
Commitment to scrimmage sessions and intramural refereeing

promises.title: Campus 3v3 March Madness Showdown
promises.description: Open 3v3 tournament for 32 student teams with live DJ and official scoring.

clubs.name: Campus Badminton & Racquet Club
clubs.tagLine: High-speed rallies, shuttlecock precision, and inter-college tournaments.
clubs.description: Catering to recreational and competitive badminton, table tennis, and squash players with indoor court reservations and weekly ladder matches.
requirements: Non-marking court shoes for indoor wooden court access
Participation in monthly club ranking ladder matches

promises.title: Inter-College Shuttle Championship
promises.description: Host 12 visiting universities for singles and doubles varsity divisions.

clubs.name: Pulse Esports & Competitive Gaming Guild
clubs.tagLine: Tactical FPS, MOBA collegiate championships, and esports broadcasting.
clubs.description: Campus esports league competing in Valorant, League of Legends, Rocket League, and CS2 collegiate tournaments with dedicated LAN streaming production.
requirements: Competitive rank requirements in relevant title (or caster/production interest)
Good team communication and zero toxicity policy

promises.title: LAN Arena Fall Invitational
promises.description: Organize physical 10-team LAN tournament with casters and live stage projection.

clubs.name: ShutterSpeed Photography & Cinema Collective
clubs.tagLine: Capturing fleeting campus light, editorial portraits, and visual stories.
clubs.description: The official photojournalism and cinematography crew for university events. We host darkroom photo walks, drone masterclasses, and Lightroom color grading workshops.
requirements: Access to DSLR/Mirrorless camera or high-end smartphone camera
Enthusiasm for event photo coverage and visual storytelling
Attendance at weekend campus photo walks

promises.title: Annual Campus Life Photo Gallery
promises.description: Curate physical 50-print photo exhibition in the central library atrium.

promises.title: Adobe Lightroom & RAW Editing Workshop
promises.description: Hands-on post-processing techniques for portraits and low-light concert photography.

clubs.name: Lens & Horizon Film Society
clubs.tagLine: Documentary filmmaking, indie short films, and visual cinematography.
clubs.description: Supporting aspiring cinematographers, video editors, and sound designers. We produce campus documentary features and short films for collegiate film festivals.
requirements: Interest in camera operation, lighting, scriptwriting, or editing
Collaboration on a semester short film project

promises.title: 48-Hour Student Film Challenge
promises.description: Campus-wide filmmaking sprint with 15 participating teams and jury screening.

clubs.name: GreenCampus Eco & Sustainability Movement
clubs.tagLine: Zero-waste initiatives, renewable energy awareness, and urban tree planting.
clubs.description: Spearheading sustainability on campus with composting stations, recycling drives, solar workshops, and biodiversity conservation campaigns.
requirements: Passion for environmental stewardship and sustainability
Available for monthly weekend campus cleanups and tree plantation drives

promises.title: 500-Sapling Campus Afforestation Drive
promises.description: Plant native fruit and shade trees across the university periphery.

clubs.name: Rotaract & Youth Humanitarian Brigade
clubs.tagLine: Community welfare, blood donation drives, and underprivileged child tutoring.
clubs.description: Dedicated to impactful grassroots community work. We run weekend literacy camps, emergency relief collections, and annual campus health drives.
requirements: Commitment to altruism and community welfare
Attendance at bi-weekly community outreach projects

promises.title: Mega Campus Blood Donation Camp
promises.description: Partner with Red Cross to collect 250+ units of emergency blood supplies.

clubs.name: Growth Pulse & Brand Strategy Guild
clubs.tagLine: Performance marketing, viral campaign strategy, and creator sponsorships.
clubs.description: Hands-on marketing think-tank managing sponsor brand deals, Instagram/LinkedIn growth funnels, and data-driven ad analytics for college festivals.
requirements: Interest in social media growth, copywriting, analytics, or sales
Creativity in formulating viral campaign hooks

promises.title: Annual Fest Sponsorship Drive
promises.description: Secure $15,000 in corporate and venture sponsorships for college events.

clubs.name: Campus Public Relations & Communications Forum
clubs.tagLine: Press releases, media partnerships, and corporate sponsorship relations.
clubs.description: Connecting campus organizations with Fortune 500 sponsors, tech media outlets, and managing festival press conferences.
requirements: Strong verbal and written English communication skills
Professional demeanor in interacting with corporate liaisons

promises.title: University Media Roundup Newsletter
promises.description: Publish monthly curated dossier of student organization achievements.

clubs.name: E-Cell: Entrepreneurship & Venture Hub
clubs.tagLine: Fostering the next wave of student founders and angel-backed ventures.
clubs.description: Incubating student-led business ideas, connecting campus startups with alumni investors, and teaching lean startup methodologies.
requirements: Interest in venture creation or startup operations
Willingness to conduct customer discovery interviews

promises.title: Campus Shark Tank Pitch Day
promises.description: Organize pitch competition with $5,000 non-dilutive micro-grant funding.
